name: Long Courtship
overview: The Scriptures emphasize the sacred union between a man and his wife, highlighting the profound commitment of becoming one flesh as established in Genesis 2:24 and reaffirmed in Matthew 19:5. This union requires patience and steadfast faith, as exemplified by the endurance of the saints who keep God's commandments and maintain faith in Jesus (Revelation 14:12). Additionally, the seriousness of willful sin after receiving truth (Hebrews 10:26) underscores the importance of walking faithfully through all seasons, including the waiting and trust involved in a long courtship.
